user.title: Connect to micam-web
user.description: Address and credentials of the micam-web bridge. On a LAN this is usually port 8080 (HTTP); if you use the self-signed 8443 listener, enable HTTPS and turn off certificate validation.

voice.title: Default voice and speed
voice.description: Pick the default voice and speaking rate. You can change it later in the integration options.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach this address. Check IP, port and that micam-web is running

speak.name: Speak on camera
speak.description: Synthesize text and play it through the camera speaker.

stop.name: Stop speaking
stop.description: End the current camera speaker session.
